summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a news release dated October 5, 2026, announcing a non-brokered private placement. The company proposes to sell up to 4,273,505 units at $2.34 per unit for gross proceeds of approximately $10.0 million. Each unit comprises one common share and one 36-month warrant exercisable at $2.75. Proceeds will advance the Morrison project and for general corporate purposes. The offering requires TSX Venture Exchange conditional approval and is subject to a four-month-plus-one-day statutory hold and six-month contractual lock-up. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
